name: Tu hài
summary: Tu hài is one of the special-zone foods, sold by the kilogram or by a count per kilogram. The harbor boards also write it tự hài, and list tu hài tự nhiên apart from tu hài thường.
howToEat: Order it by weight. Island seafood is at its best in winter, before the spring spawn.
where: Đường 1/4, đường Núi Ngọc, and the quay kitchens at Bến Bèo.
